analysis.reasonEn: RSI weakened at 35.4, re-entering oversold territory. ADX at 25.0 indicates a trend, but -DI at 35.9 dominates +DI at 14.7, suggesting continued downtrend potential. 5-day low at 206,500 and 20-day low at 204,500 hint at an early Higher Low pattern, but low volume ratio (0.59) reduces confidence. 4H RSI at 29.0 also in oversold.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (214,500 KRW) below SMA5 (216,600 KRW), SMA20 (250,450 KRW), SMA50 (255,070 KRW): diagnosing short- to mid-term weak trend position.
· Below SMA100 (275,100 KRW), SMA200 (233,991 KRW): assessing mid- to long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (42.9%) + current price approaching historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (27.7→35.4): insufficient oversold exit, failed to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6369.5467→-4626.7408): improving, in weak convergence zone.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 197,511 KRW): approaching lower band, band width wide at 42.27%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (204,500 KRW): based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (223,000 KRW): potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (early Higher Low entry): exploring potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (potential accumulation phase): meeting conditions for wait-and-see.
